name: Question Intelligence
_comment_depends_on: Only M04 is a real runtime upstream. M01, M02 and M03 reach this module as
FIELDS ON A REQUEST that M06 assembles - coverage_debt on SelectionRequest,
grounding on /v1/questions/generate - so there is no client for them here
and listing them as dependencies would be lineage dressed up as coupling.
Nothing is required: true. A missing upstream narrows scope, never quality.

depends_on.name: Skill Graph & MNEMOS Memory
depends_on.reason: the concept ontology every item is tagged against, and the posterior that seeds a session's provisional theta
depends_on.on_missing: Concepts come from the committed 120-concept ontology snapshot instead, stamped with its ontology_version. Items are authored, selected and calibrated normally; theta starts cold rather than seeded, which is the correct behaviour for an unseen candidate anyway.

depends_on.name: Evaluation Engine
depends_on.reason: scores the answers that give an item its Elo, and eventually its IRT parameters
depends_on.on_missing: Items are served and never scored, so no responses accrue: Elo stays at its prior and the bank cannot calibrate. Selection still works - that is what the cold-start path in 6.5 is for.

_comment_feeds: These consume M05. QuestionPackage and SelectionResult are contracts five
modules read; additive changes are safe, renames are not.

feeds.takes: the next question, chosen against a provisional theta this module owns
the question package: stem, reference answer, key points, concepts, item parameters
viva items grounded on the student's own project
bank coverage per concept, to say what practice is even available
